name: ReplaceNullWithValueNode
label: Replace Null with Value
description: Replaces null/empty values in one or more columns with a specified replacement value. When no columns are given, all columns are processed.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: ColumnsToClean
fields.label: Columns To Clean
fields.description: Optional comma-separated column names to process. Leave empty to process all columns.

fields.name: ReplacementValue
fields.label: Replacement Value
fields.description: The value used to replace null/empty cells.

fields.name: AlsoTreatWhitespaceAsNull
fields.label: Also Treat Whitespace As Null
fields.description: True to also treat whitespace-only strings as null. Defaults to false.

fields.name: CleanedDataTable
fields.label: Cleaned Data Table
fields.description: The resulting data table with nulls replaced.
